ai.title: System prompt restricts long-running scripts
ai.summary: Added instruction to backend/src/system-prompt.ts forbidding execution of long-running scripts like npm run dev. Prevents terminal hangs from non-exiting processes. Affects all agent sessions via core system prompt.

eli5.text: When you ask the coding assistant to help with a project, the instructions it follows now tell it to avoid starting long-running processes like a local development server that never closes on its own. This keeps the tool from getting stuck waiting for a server to finish, which used to hang the session. Since this is part of the assistant's core guidance, every agent session is affected the moment it follows these updated instructions.

ai.title: Add test for multiple diff blocks in single file
ai.summary: Added test case to `process-file-block.test.ts` verifying `processFileBlock` handles multiple SEARCH/REPLACE blocks in one file. Validates patch application via `applyPatch` ensures both blocks are processed correctly. Scope limited to test suite.

eli5.text: Nothing changes for anyone today: the team added new checks that make sure the assistant correctly rewrites several sections of one file at the same time. These checks live only in the testing area, so they do not change any live behavior.

ai.title: system-prompt: make terminal build checks optional, move long-running
ai.summary: backend/src/system-prompt.ts reframes the post-edit verification section from mandatory to optional, instructing the agent to check knowledge files for a specified protocol before running terminal commands. The long-running command prohibition (e.g., npm run dev) moved from the run_terminal_command use-cases list to the tool guidelines, with added rationale that users must wait for completion. Scope limited to the backend system prompt; no CLI, Web, or Desktop surfaces affected. The two separate knowledge-file fallback paragraphs merged into one.

eli5.text: When the assistant makes a code change, it now only runs follow-up checks (like tests or type-checking) if the project's own instructions explicitly ask for them. Previously, it was expected to verify changes automatically after each edit. This affects how the assistant behaves behind the scenes during development tasks; the long-running command rule was clarified so the assistant won't start a server that never finishes. If you watched the assistant work, you might notice it skips the extra verification step unless the knowledge files say to do it, and it avoids commands that wait indefinitely.

ai.title: Add empty state text for file blocks and file trees
ai.summary: System prompt generation appends 'There are no files selected yet.' when fileBlockSets is empty. File tree printing returns '[No files in this directory.]' if nodes length is zero. Changes affect backend/src/system-prompt.ts and common/src/util/file.ts. Provides explicit context to the model when no files are included.

eli5.text: When you haven't picked any files to work with, the assistant now sees a clear note saying 'There are no files selected yet.' instead of just an empty space, and if you open a folder that has nothing in it, you'll see '[No files in this directory.]' rather than confusion. The assistant can now give you better context when no files are involved.
